Harrison County by the numbers

The Census Bureau's 2019-2023 survey counts 65,407 people and 30,537 housing units in Harrison County, which ranks 7 of 13 West Virginia counties here. Median home value is $158,500, which is about level with the middle county in this West Virginia set. Households here earn a median $58,326; the middle West Virginia county is at $58,326. 26% of occupied homes are rented, which leaves 74% owner-occupied. The median home was built in 1963, about 60 years ago.
